text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to interpret and understand the visual world. It uses techniques like image recognition to identify objects, people, or scenes in photos and videos. Object detection goes further, locating specific items within an image, such as faces or traffic signs. These technologies have many practical applications, from security systems and medical imaging to retail and entertainment. One of the most exciting uses is in self-driving cars, which rely on computer vision to detect pedestrians, other vehicles, and road signs, helping the car navigate safely without human input.
